description.narrative: REFRAKA brings together women communicators who are members of community radios throughout Haiti. Community radios are spaces for information and popular education and play an important role in promoting/sharing information through their proximity to local populations. The network works on the promotion and respect of women's rights, particularly those living in rural communities. It raises awareness among rural women and girls in order to better understand their rights and defend them.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- Capacity building for women working in community radios (training on gender, social and economic rights, digital technology, health, agro-ecology);- Awareness raising and promotion of women's rights (production on social and economic rights, sexual and reproductive rights, agro-ecology and the health crisis);- Strengthening the reach of the radio (creation of a web radio platform/radio application.)
